result.question: Como se distribuem os hospitais em quartis de volume de internações? Mostre o número de hospitais e o intervalo de internações por quartil.
result.gold_sql: SELECT ntile_grupo, COUNT(*) AS total_hospitais, MIN(total_internacoes) AS min_internacoes, MAX(total_internacoes) AS max_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(total_internacoes), 0) AS media_internacoes FROM (SELECT "CNES", total_internacoes, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes) AS ntile_grupo FROM (SELECT "CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes GROUP BY "CNES") sub) ranked GROUP BY ntile_grupo ORDER BY ntile_grupo;
result.generated_sql: WITH hospital_volume AS ( SELECT h."CNES", COUNT(i."N_AIH") AS total_internacoes FROM hospital h JOIN internacoes i ON h."CNES" = i."CNES" GROUP BY h."CNES" ), quartis AS ( SELECT total_internacoes, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes) AS quartil FROM hospital_volume ) SELECT quartil, COUNT(*) AS numero_hospitais, MIN(total_internacoes) AS intervalo_inferior, MAX(total_internacoes) AS intervalo_superior FROM quartis GROUP BY quartil ORDER BY quartil;
